description: Sealing room library (vs_king) on the shared run host: unseal opens one system run per king stage; joining, explicit combat, ＠ふういん, chest inspection, Dejon removal and exit run in the host's per-command transaction (C1, C2 through runhost).

transaction_boundaries.note: One runhost Open per stage (runs row only, no character locks) after the unseal commits; unseal news follows outside any transaction.

＠ふういん under runhost Command, which already holds the run and the sorted roster character locks: updates Hero Count, creates chests and returns the news write (Effects.Settled, after the Settler) and the celebration (Effects.Committed, after commit only).
Dejon fatigue applied by runhost Command to an already-locked character after the Settler; the host releases the member's enrollment.
Slot reads only; the runhost SweepIdle worker deletes idle rooms.
